Refactored the SSG onto a plugin pipeline. All external APIs (`build`, `parseMarkdownFile`, `listMarkdownFiles`, `render*`, `startDevServer`, `injectReloadScript`, `parseArgs`, …) are unchanged and behavior is identical (verified by the existing 42 tests plus smoke-testing the compiled CLI build/serve).

- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`/`beforeBuild`/`afterBuild`/`onFile(page)`/`onEnd`) and `PluginPipeline`, which runs every hook across all plugins in registration order.
- **`src/engine.ts`** — core `SSGEngine` orchestrating the pipeline: start → beforeBuild → onFile(per page) → afterBuild → write outputs → onEnd. `loadConfig()` reads `ssg.config.ts` from cwd (falls back to built-ins); `fromOptions()` also accepts `plugins`/`configFile` in `BuildOptions`.
- **Built-in plugins**: `src/plugins/markdown.ts` (`MarkdownPlugin` parses files in `beforeBuild`), `src/plugins/templates.ts` (`TemplatePlugin` renders pages in `onFile` and the index in `afterBuild`), `src/plugins/dev-server.ts` (`DevServerPlugin` broadcasts reload via `afterBuild` and owns serve/rebuild/close; `startDevServer` wired through it).
- **`./plugins/`** — TypeScript modules (`markdown.ts`, `templates.ts`, `dev-server.ts`) exposing the built-ins, plus root **`ssg.config.ts`** that lists them.
- Render helpers moved to `src/render.ts`; `src/ssg.ts` and `src/serve.ts` re-export the full prior API.
- Added `tests/plugin.test.ts` + `tests/fixtures/config/ssg.config.ts` covering pipeline ordering, custom `onFile` transforms, extra outputs, options plugins, and config loading.
